description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'SavePayGradeController' within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling the pre-rendering logic for the 'save pay grade' view, determining whether to load an 'edit' or 'add' component based on request attributes.

classes.name: SavePayGradeController
classes.description: A controller class extending AbstractVueController, managing the pre-render process for save pay grade operations, setting the appropriate Vue component based on request data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component to be rendered by checking if there is an existing 'id' in the request attributes; if so, it sets up an 'edit' component with the pay grade ID, otherwise, it sets up an 'add' component.
